value.body: Housekeeping executives keep a hotel's rooms and public spaces clean, stocked and ready for guests. They plan staff duties, inspect rooms, manage linen and supplies, and keep front office updated on which rooms are ready. Hospitals, serviced apartments and facility-management firms also hire for similar roles.

items.label: Common starting titles
items.value: Housekeeping associate, floor supervisor, desk executive

items.label: BHM students enrolled
items.note: All years, all modes; related degrees such as BHMCT are counted separately

items.label: BHM pass-outs a year
items.source: AISHE 2023-24 (Ministry of Education), institutions that reported

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually enter through BHM campus placement or management trainee rotations, starting as housekeeping associates or floor supervisors. Facility-management firms also hire BHM graduates for supervisory roles in offices and hospitals.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next steps: assistant executive housekeeper, executive housekeeper, rooms division manager.
Skills carry over to hospital and facility management roles.
